title: Home practical guide and safety card: ruler and glasses pitch test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 17 (Home practical guide and safety card: ruler and glasses pitch test (portal worksheet; tap gently, adult present with glass))
intro: Lesson 17: Pitch: high and low sounds. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how the length of a ruler or the water in a glass changes the pitch
equipment: A plastic or wooden ruler (not metal)
safety: Tap gently, adult present with glass
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Hold the ruler firmly on the table edge with 20 cm sticking out
Twang it gently, away from faces, and listen to the pitch
Repeat with 15 cm and 10 cm sticking out
With an adult, fill three glasses with different amounts of water
Tap each glass gently with the spoon
Record which is highest and lowest in pitch

questions.q: Big question: why does a mouse squeak but an elephant rumbles?
questions.a: Smaller vibrating parts vibrate faster, giving a higher pitch.
